text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса arrives at summer camp
and
learns of a festival nearby where
locals wear
masks and dance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса can feel the spirit of the

mascarada in the masks and dance of the
event,
causing her excitement for the
event to grow
further.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Already taking a surprising turn, it looks
like
another passionate summer camp is
in store for El
Condor Pasa!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
